title: Silicon anchor: trace-driven PHYSICAL replay of controller-arm encoder dispatch on RTX 5090
design: {'principle': "One GPU cannot host a time-shared fake fleet without distorting physics. The defensible physical test is a TRACE-DRIVEN PHYSICAL REPLAY: take each controller arm's ACTUAL batch dispatch sequence from the frozen simulation artifacts, execute that exact sequence on the real encoder, measure per-batch wall service time, and compare per-batch and per-request against the banked f(N) simulation.", 'dispatch_provenance': 'Batch sequences are NOT stored by the original runs. They are regenerated by re-running workload/trace_to_two_pool.py with the SAME frozen arguments (offset, max-requests, --encoder-workers 2, --worker-schedule <frozen sched.json>) plus the strictly-additive --batches-out dump flag, then GATED against the banked stats (batches/forwards/images/busy/provisioned/delay percentiles must match exactly). See simulation/silicon_anchor_extract.py.', 'comparisons_emitted_per_rep': ["A. per-batch paired: measured wall service vs the sim's AIC-predicted service, over the  | REORDER 2 (author): tier 3 calm-day promoted over tier 2 -- resource-time story lands before the long burst-coverage tail.

clock_gate.throttle_policy: The delivered SM band is the binding criterion. Only slowdown bits stop a measurement: HwSlowdown 0x8 | SyncBoost 0x10 | SwThermalSlowdown 0x20 | HwThermalSlowdown 0x40 | HwPowerBrake 0x80 (mask 0xf8). Benign bits seen under normal locked load -- GpuIdle 0x1, ApplicationsClocksSetting 0x2, SwPowerCap 0x4, DisplayClockSetting 0x100 -- are RECORDED as evidence (clock.jsonl + rep.json throttle_evidence) but do not gate, because at 380 W the card raises SwPowerCap while still delivering 2385 MHz, i.e. inside the locked band. Measured live 2026-07-27: strict throttle_hex==0 idled the runner 60 s out of every ~140 s of measuring while protecting nothing the SM band did not already protect.
clock_gate.on_violation: WAIT (poll every 60 s, log every poll to daemon.log and every 10th to the manifest) -- never measure on unlocked/boost clocks, never silently proceed

execution.convention: 448^2 -> 28x28 patch grid -> 196 post-merge tokens/image, exactly the master anchor convention (anchor_sdpa_locked2400.json protocol)
execution.input_buffers: one preallocated (28*28*64, 1536) bf16 pixel buffer + (64,3) grid buffer, SLICED per batch -- zero per-batch allocation, exact shapes

extension.note: UNBOUNDED. Entered only after every tier has reached its min_reps.

phase_a.cells: all tier 1-4 cells, tie broken by tier then queue order (so burst3 leads)

phase_b.note: other folds and other batch regimes; see extension.long_tail

folds.note: F1 has no forecast coverage; its fc arm does not exist by construction (run_encoder_hybrid_folds.sh documents the refusal)

batch_regimes.note: the CALIBRATION split -- physically valid, but must never be reported as evaluation evidence; label them calibration

extension.after_phase_b: return to phase_a with until_reps += 10, forever

stop.checked: between reps AND between segments; a mid-rep stop banks the partial segment and resumes exactly there on restart

tiers.name: burst3 x {fc_p90, reactive, static_C8}
tiers.rationale: Most decisive cell: the smallest headline episode, so a full 3-arm comparison lands first; burst3 is also the window with the banked FIFO physical replay (collector_artifacts/phaseE_physical_anchor/burst3_fifo_replay.json), giving an independent cross-check of the new runner.

burst3__fc.source_run: simulation/comparator_frontier_eval.sh (the frozen §8.2 decisive-baseline evaluation run; replay() at line ~64)
burst3__fc.controller: forecast p90, issue-time actuation (chronos 15s, rho=15, hyst 3min, L=30s)
burst3__fc.est_basis: exact: master-anchor measured f(N) summed over the cell's REAL dumped batch sequence (anchor_sdpa_locked2400.json); band = -3%/+5% for per-batch launch overhead and run-to-run drift

tiers.name: engine diversity (vLLM serving vs HF eager) on anchor shapes
tiers.rationale: Diversity across ENGINES rather than windows: the same shapes measured through three kernel stacks bounds how much of the measured/AIC gap is stack-specific.

engine__hf_sdpa.note: Re-runs the master anchor protocol exactly; also the runner's own calibration tie-back.

engine__hf_fa2.note: Production-kernel bound; banked fa2 is faster than sdpa at high N (465.7 vs 511.3 at N=64).

engine__vllm_serving.note: vLLM's own Qwen3_VisionTransformer (FLASH_ATTN, eager) -- the serving path AIC composes. Requires the pinned image; preflighted, and SKIPPED (not failed) if absent.

tiers.name: calm-day slice (steady24h) x arms
tiers.rationale: Low-load regime: batches are mostly N=1 (p50=1 img/batch), which exercises the small-N end of f(N) where the measured/AIC ratio is LOWEST (1.32) -- the opposite corner from the bursts and the one that tests whether the controller gap is regime-dependent.

tiers.name: F6 / e13 fold x {fc, re, hybrid}
tiers.rationale: The e13 breaker fold: the only fold where both pure policies miss the SLA (fc p99 1264 ms, re 1229 ms) and the hybrid recovers it (679 ms). Physical confirmation that the hybrid recovery survives real service times is the strongest single defense of the hybrid controller.
